compute_mps: compute monomial potentials from ABC tensors using einsum operations to derive rkkks, ramkks, and rbmkks rotation tensors
construct_bases: construct a d-by-d complex Fourier basis matrix for transforming modular addition model weights into the Fourier domain
load_model_traj: load a series of modular addition model checkpoint files from a directory and extract Fourier-transformed ABC weight tensors
process_one: process a single experiment folder by loading its model trajectory, computing monomial potentials, and returning combined results with config
review_compute_mps: review the compute_mps function to understand how it computes rkkks tensors and rotation-based ramkks and rbmkks tensors
